title: Braiding with Majorana fermions
note: Verified 2026-11-22 against the SPIE Digital Library record (Proc. SPIE 9873, 98730E, published 19 May 2016) and the arXiv PDF 1603.07827, which states the Clifford Braiding Theorem (tau_k = (1 + c_{k+1}c_k)/sqrt2 represent the circular Artin braid group). This is the paper Gresnigt 2017 (arXiv:1711.09011, ref. [14]) cites for that theorem; kauffman-lomonaco-2007 (quant-ph/0606114) does not contain it.
